### `scanned-agreement.pdf` (scanned)

Image-only addendum rendered from known synthetic text. Has no text layer by design, so PDF.js must report it as unusable.

**Document warnings:**

- 1 of 1 page(s) carry an image but no text layer. PDF.js reads existing text; it does not perform OCR, so a scanned document yields nothing.

**Fallback reasons:** `scanned-no-text-layer`, `all-pages-empty`
